name: Power Up!
extDescription:
Activate this Skill during your Main Phase.
Once per Duel, you can make 1 face-up monster on the field gain 500 ATK until the end of this turn.

name: Dark Magician Girl
extDescription: Gains 300 ATK for every "Dark Magician" or "Magician of Black Chaos" in the GY.

name: Rogue Doll
extDescription: A deadly doll gifted with mystical power, it is particularly powerful when attacking against dark forces.

name: Shard of Greed
extDescription: Each time you draw a card(s) for your normal draw in your Draw Phase, place 1 Greed Counter on this card. You can send this card with 2 or more Greed Counters to the GY; draw 2 cards.

name: Skull Dice
extDescription: Roll a six-sided die. All monsters your opponent currently controls lose ATK/DEF equal to the result x 100, until the end of this turn.

name: Windstorm of Etaqua
extDescription: Change the battle positions of all face-up monsters your opponent controls.

name: Bandit
extDescription: If your LP are 1500 or less, activate this Skill. Take control of 1 Set card in your opponent's Spell & Trap Zone. This Skill can only be used once per Duel.
